dedupe_keys.name: hifld open hydrocarbon gas liquid pipelines

description: HIFLD Open Hydrocarbon Gas Liquid Pipelines is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (United States Department of Energy). Major hydrocarbon gas liquids (HGL) pipelines in the United States and selected HGL pipelines in Canada. This data includes interstate trunk lines and selected intrastate lines. Based on publicly available data from a variety of sources (including company websites and media reports) with varying scales and levels of accuracy. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
